citedEvidence.claim: The backlog records a tension: MCPClient combines several high-risk responsibilities that should be split or documented.

currentStructure.description: stateful client class carries auth, retry, rate limiting, pagination, and endpoint wrappers

dreams.idea: Move the high-risk client responsibilities behind a ClientPort seam owned by server wiring.

proposedStructure.description: server wiring depends on a narrow client port while sub-responsibilities become separately testable
proposedStructure.toCarrier: ClientPort seam owned by server wiring

dreams.rationale: The cited high-risk multi-responsibility tension supports moving behavior to a different carrier seam rather than adding one local test.

validationRecipe.action: build a ClientPort seam and measure graph fan-in before and after
